Summer Day Camp 2027

Tumblestone Brook Nature Camp is a small, outdoors-based day camp run by the Tumblestone Brook Nature Association. Campers spend their days outside: wading in the brook, building shelters, tracking animals and learning to sit quietly and notice what is around them.

Our camp is for children ages 7 to 12. Groups are kept small and each group stays with the same two counselors all week.

2027 Sessions

Each session runs Monday through Friday. Campers arrive at 9:00 AM at the Brookside Pavilion. Please bring a lunch, water bottle, and a change of clothes; we provide snacks.

SessionDatesStartCost
Week 1: Brook ExplorersJune 28 – July 2, 20279:00 AM$285 per week
Week 2: Wild BuildersJuly 12 – July 16, 20279:00 AM$285 per week

A typical day runs until mid-afternoon, with a closing circle at the pavilion before families come to pick up. Staff will confirm the exact pickup routine with each family in June.

Registration

Registration opens February 3, 2027; members January 27. Spaces fill quickly, especially for Week 3. Register online through the link below once registration opens.

Register for camp

Tumblestone Brook Nature Association members receive early access to registration. Questions? Call the office at (802) 555-0142 or write to camp@tumblestone-example.org.
